summary: Operator-only code-index build and rebuild controls.

tools.notes: Optional control that prepares the repo code index for a configured workspace repository now. Queries answer from the published index and request background refresh; explicit build waits for current HEAD. A dirty worktree is reported, never refused. A cache path that is not git-ignored refuses with cache_path_not_ignored. CLI fallback: `npm run wiki -- code-index build --json --dir <repo>`.
use_when: Preparation that waits for current HEAD is explicitly wanted; queries answer from the published index and request background refresh.
do_not_use_when: A code-index query is about to run; queries answer from the published index and request background refresh.

recommended_first_call.operation: prepare the configured workspace code index

tools.notes: Optional control that forces a clean rebuild of the repo code index for a configured workspace repository, re-extracting every committed source. Queries answer from the published index and request background refresh; explicit rebuild waits for current HEAD. A dirty worktree is reported, never refused. A cache path that is not git-ignored refuses with cache_path_not_ignored. CLI fallback: `npm run wiki -- code-index rebuild --json --dir <repo>`.
use_when: A clean re-extraction of every committed source is explicitly wanted.
do_not_use_when: The index only needs to be current; queries refresh it automatically.

recommended_first_call.operation: force a clean rebuild of the configured workspace code index
